                    ### Question
                    Which of the following constitutes an advantage of the gamma interferon (IGRA) release assays against the tuberculin skin test in the diagnosis of latent tuberculosis infection?

                    ### Options
                    opa. Avoid false positives from previous BCG vaccination.
opb. It has a greater capacity to predict reactivation tuberculosis.
opc. It has a greater ability to predict the efficacy of prophylaxis with isoniazid.
opd. Avoid false negatives due to anergy in highly immunosuppressed patients.

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Gamma interferon (IGRA) release assays are more specific than tuberculin skin tests, avoiding false positives from previous BCG vaccination. They have a greater ability to predict reactivation tuberculosis by correlating with the risk of progression to active disease. IGRA results can guide treatment decisions, including the efficacy of prophylaxis with isoniazid. Additionally, IGRA assays avoid false negatives due to anergy in highly immunosuppressed patients, improving diagnostic accuracy in this population.
